headline: 寶萊塢風潮多點開花
context: Netflix新片《Best of the Best》以寶萊塢舞蹈社為背景，講述兩位好友從相知到互相較勁的校園喜劇，由少數在好萊塢工作的穆斯林女性導演蘭娜．汗（Lena Khan）執導。同時，英國阿爾德肖特出身的兄弟檔The Twins，正以自創的『寶萊塢電子』曲風受到樂評關注，本週推出新單曲《Wish U》。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: What’s engaging in this tale of two best girl friends and a dance competition is not the familiar plot but the whip-fast telling and brilliant choreograpy There is absolutely nothing unexpected about this Netflix comedy set in the world of rival Bollywood dance groups on American campuses. Each plot twist is instantly familiar, every character recognisable, the essential formula untweaked from a dozen previous college comedies. But it’s funny and snappy, and directed with infectious energy by Lena Khan, one of the few Muslim female film-makers working in Hollywood. The scriptwriters are Hasan Minhaj and Prashanth Venkataramanujam, a pair of millennial comedians who look as if they’ve done enough research on the inner workings of gen Z behaviour to write a PhD. Maya (Maitreyi Ramakrishnan) and Anjali (Priyanka Kedia) star as lifelong best friends who enrol together at UCLA. Maya is the clever difficult one; Anjali is the nice pretty one. (It goes without saying Maya is also a total babe.) During freshers’ week they join the college’s Bollywood dance club where, predictably, Maya locks horns with leader Ronak (Ankur Rathee) over the choreography. He wants to base their new-season routine on Bollywood weddings, which, as Maya points out, is a bit trad. If they are going to beat their rivals they will need to come up with something modern and fresh. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Omar and Jamal Ikram, 21-year-old brothers, are making lo-fi glitchy dance-pop with the melodic sensibilities of Bollywood music From Aldershot, Hampshire Recommended if you like 2hollis, the Hellp, Jai Paul Up next New single Wish U out now You, like me, may be growing tired of the 2020s’ so-called “indie sleaze” revival, which has so far yielded a few good parties and not that much good music. But the music of the Twins – Aldershot-born brothers Omar and Jamal Ikram – is made of sturdier stuff. The 21-year-olds are progenitors of a sound they call “Bollywood electronic” – a strain of loud, lo-fi, ultra-glitchy dance-pop that sounds like 2hollis if his songs were heavy with screwy samples of south Asian pop. Their debut album, last year’s Turmeric, captures the still-potent appeal of Jai Paul’s classic Str8 Outta Mumbai – which fused the lackadaisical sheen of 2010s electronic pop with the shining rhythmic and melodic sensibilities of Bollywood music – and, as is de rigueur for the contemporary era, makes it bolshie and frenetic, taking in the euphoric aggression of early Skrillex and unnerving noise of Aphex Twin. Turmeric was a minor hit, thanks in part to Fuckersby, a collaboration with on-the-rise British rapper Fakemink, as well as the Twins’ monthly NTS show, also called Turmeric , which turns one this month. (Its combination of classic British pop stars such as Lily Allen, Punjabi artists such as Sukshinder Shinda, and contemporary electronic acts the Hellp and Sophia Stel gives it the feeling of a late-night pirate radio station totally out of time and place.) The duo’s follow-up EP There&Back, released in May, polishes up the Twins’ sound a little, but not that much – if anything, their collaborations with Rada and Varg2TM on There&Back are even louder and wilder than anything on Turmeric. The duo’s future plans aren’t clear, but their mission is: “We don’t want brown kids to feel like they have to fit into anything,” Jamal said in an interview. “People are always gonna try to label what you’re doing, but you don’t have to move like that.” Shaad D’Souza Continue reading...

threads_text:
Netflix新片《Best of the Best》把場景設定在寶萊塢舞蹈社，講述兩位好友從相知到互相較勁的校園喜劇，劇情走的是熟悉的公式，但節奏明快、編舞出色，執導的蘭娜．汗（Lena Khan）是少數在好萊塢工作的穆斯林女性導演。另一邊，英國阿爾德肖特出身的21歲兄弟檔The Twins，正以自創的『寶萊塢電子』曲風受到樂評關注，這種融合寶萊塢旋律與粗糙電子節拍的曲風，本週隨新單曲《Wish U》再度受到矚目。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 18 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 寶萊塢風格，這週在戲院跟音樂圈都很熱。Netflix新片《Best of the Best》，把故事場景設定在寶萊塢舞蹈社，講兩個好朋友從相知到互相較勁。執導的是少數在好萊塢工作的穆斯林女性導演。另一邊，英國有一對21歲的兄弟檔，自創了『寶萊塢電子』這種曲風，把寶萊塢的旋律和粗糙的電子節拍揉在一起，本週推出新單曲，也受到樂評關注。
